# WolrdPulse

> WolrdPulse is an open-source Model Context Protocol (MCP) server for real-time cloud outage status (AWS, Vercel, GitHub), DNS-over-HTTPS resolution, SSL/TLS certificate inspection, and global edge latency probes for Claude Desktop, Cursor, and Windsurf. It is not the World Pulse social network and not the WorldPulse weather product.

## Quick Connect

- SSE, no API key: https://wolrdpulse.app/sse
- Local stdio: `npx -y github:Mealiclay01/wolrdpulse`
- Server key in client config: `wolrdpulse`

## MCP Tools

- [Cloud status](https://wolrdpulse.app/en/tools/cloud-status): `get_cloud_status` reads public outage feeds.
- [SSL inspector](https://wolrdpulse.app/en/tools/ssl-inspector): `inspect_ssl` reads the TLS certificate on port 443.
- [DNS resolver](https://wolrdpulse.app/en/tools/dns-resolver): `query_dns` asks Cloudflare 1.1.1.1. `inspect_dns` is the same call.
- [Edge pings](https://wolrdpulse.app/en/tools/edge-pings): `ping_endpoint` returns HTTP status and time to first byte.

## IDE Integrations
